notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[i][b]Please Note: This development update is from 9th July 2023. All development logs are posted to Patreon backers first as well as on our Discord for owners of the DLC.[/b][/i]

Hey guys!

To kick things off this week with our development update, I'm going to dive right in and say it's been another incredible and productive week. I've had some time off work, and I've used that time wisely... by working none-stop on The Artist We are now just a few poses shy from being halfway through!

We would have been past halfway by now, but we have one early scene that is proving quite troublesome with being rendered by the batch renderer. There are over 200 images to render, and there's something in the scene that is kicking up a stink. So that's on my to-do list to go back and remove the pesky thing so I can batch render and forget about it.

We have been approached by a translator, who has kindly offered to translate The Artist into Chinese. This was only a few days ago, and he is already working his way through Act One. We hope that this will make The Artist more accesible for more and more players across the world - an amazing feeling in itself!

Whilst my PC has been rendering, I have been investigating different animation techniques. Originally, all the animation done in The Artist was done natively in DAZ. Now, if you've ever used DAZ to render, you'll know that it's a pain in the arse. I've landed on a piece of software that works with DAZ relatively easily, and with a few test scenes and getting the hang of the workspace, I am super happy with the results. I am able to animate A LOT of things in less than half the time it would have taken me in DAZ, and with much more realistic results, including an IK system that actually works!

Our progress graph has now been updated to show the current stage. Totally forgot to update that last week so it's been out of date for longer than I realised! All is well now though :)

That's all for this week. Looking to have another productive week in the one to come and should have smashed the halfway mark by the time I update you guys again :)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[i][b]Please Note: This development update is from 9th July 2023. All development logs are posted to Patreon backers first as well as on our Discord for owners of the DLC.[/b][/i]

This week has been an amazing week for development. Following on from the completely written dialgue of Act Two, we are already [i][b]a third of the way through posing and rendering the still images![/b][/i]

We've had The Artist released on Steam for a week now. So far, the feedback has been great and the number of players has gone far beyond what we could have imagined! (#10 on 'New and Trending' for AVN's on Steam) To say we are really enjoying how well it's been received over there is an understatement :)

It's still early in development, but we are remaining optimistic in how quickly the next update will arrive. We originally pencilled in 3 months from the release of Act One, to having a build ready for our Patreons to play first. As we are a third of the way through after only a few weeks, it wouldn't surprise me if we got things done ahead of time. 

Earlier on in development, we were discussing the possibility of having an OST for The Artist. It's something I've always wanted to do, and up until recently it seemed a little out of our scope. It was a chore to try and find someone whose style matched what I wanted, or even to get anyone to reply after the initial messages! HOWEVER! We may have found a composer/ musician who is prepared to create an entire OST for The Artist, and all other future stories released under Grotslot - For us, this is HUGE! We are still early in talks, but they are very keen, and so am I.

We also released a 4K Wallpaper pack featuring Ava. You guys seemed to enjoy this, and the feedback has been great. I know that development of Act Two comes first, and it always will. But as in our last post I mentioned having an incredibly productive few days, taking time to work on other things is good for the mind and helps keep things fresh - is this something you want to see more of?

That's all for this week, not too much to report on as we plough our way through the development of Act Two!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[i][b]Please Note: This development update is from 2nd July 2023. All development logs are posted to Patreon backers first as well as on our Discord for owners of the DLC.[/b][/i]

What a week it has been! 

I have updated the progress graph on the main Patreon page that gives you a more detailed look on how things are progressing for each stage. There are more elements to the development of course, but these are the basics that dictate 99% of the progress.

As you will see from the graph, ACT TWO IS COMPLETELY WRITTEN! DONE. FINITE. I do want to give major credit to our writer here. His ability to knock out scenes like an afternoon wank have made the writing process so much easier. And let me tell you, when I first got my hands on the script, my heart was racing. Not totally down to excitement; mostly because what will be happening in this Act! I wish I could give you all the script to read now, or that there was a magic button I could press to get the next major update out to you all straight away! (There isn't, I've looked)

I have finished setting up the master scenes now that I have the script, and the next job for me as the artist is to work my way through the dialogue. The first scene is completely done, and deals with where we left off with Act One. It has taken some time to get back into the swing of it. Especially with the various releases, bug fixes, marketing... everything. BUT, there's just one teeny update to come out to fix some typos and the last few crumbs of errors, and then I am 100% back in the thick of it. Once Xaos has given me the latest build for this bug fix, he will then be working on an official Android port for those that prefer to play on mobile! For future releases, it means you guys get to play on your android device without having to wait for a community port and then wait even longer for any other updates. Plus you get full support from the team if anything goes wrong! 

The Steam release went out this week, and we are absolutely LOVING the response. Super over the moon with the reception we've had, and looking over the reviews we've had, it puts a smile on our faces seeing you guys loving this as much as we hoped you would!

I am in the process of creating a DLC for the Steam version that acts as a 'Developer Donation'. At the moment, it would be an empty game file and the DLC purely serves as a one off time donation as an alternative to Patreon. I will be putting together a Steam exclusive gallery to include in that DLC that will be accesible in-game. All my 'Fan' tier subscribers (past, present, and future) will receive either the Steam key to the DLC, the standlone Steam build (if they don't want to clutter their Steam library with saucy games), or the gallery images zipped up and sent over to you. If you have any suggestions on who should feature in the gallery, what scenarios, ANYTHING - let me know in the comments or over on Discord!

That's all the update I have for you this week. Keep the feedback and excitement coming in! :)

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[i][b]Please Note: This development update is from 26th June 2023. All development logs are posted to Patreon backers first as well as on our Discord for owners of the DLC.[/b][/i]

Happy Monday my dear Supporters!!

I know I said I was going to do a dev log every Sunday, but the weather was so good yesterday that I took time away from my desk and spent it outside with the family - no regrets at all!

As for updates, the major update we can give you is that the writing has been commissioned to the end of Act Two, and is already 50% of the way through! We imagine that the writing will be complete before the month is out!

With the writing well under way, it allows me to create the stage for each scene. Now I have all the dialogue, and what characters will feature in each scene, I can set up a master file ready for me to get stuck in. This includes setting up the lights, dressing the characters, creating new scenes, and making sure everything translates over into Photoshop properly - It can be a long task, but makes the rest of the posing and rendering a breeze!

We are working on another bug fix for Act One, that looks to address some minor niggles that people picked up the more they play.

The Steam build has been approved and is good to go. There seems to be an issue with Steamworks that requires the store page to go through another review - not sure why this is but Steam are looking into it now. Once they have given the all clear, you can add it to your steam library! :)

That's all for this week. I expect the next update will see us much further along, and I will implement the progress graph to give you an idea of where we are at with Act Two!

notes.title: DLC Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hey hey hey! 

We have had an incredible week so far on the development of Act Two and now we are pleased to announce the first reward to be included in the Donation DLC - A 4K Wallpaper Pack exclusively for our supporters!

The DLC will be updated to include the wallpapers in the next few days, and those who have already purchased the DLC will get instant access as soon as it's available. The wallpapers will also be available for our supporters over on Patreon for 'Fan' Tier and above.

This pack will contain around 10 4K images of Ava, and the content leans more towards an artistic/ erotic approach rather than straight up porn!

The next reward for DLC owners will be announced in the next few days!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[i][b]Please Note: This development update is from 18th June 2023. All development logs are posted to Patreon backers first.[/b][/i]

Hey everyone!

It's been a week since Act One released, and so far we are super happy with the feedback we've receieved! We knew that telling Ava's story wouldn't be for everyone, and a lot of people have voiced their concerns over the story, the content, or whatever other reason. We appreciate all feedback, no matter how positive or negative it is; there is always something to be gained from it. We have a plan with The Artist, and that won't change. The positive feedback we've received has been overwhelming and we have loved reading all your comments - so a huge thank you to all of you!

A few days ago, I reached out to Patrons to see if there was more I could be doing to make your subscription more... worthwhile? I don't know if worthwhile is the right word, but hopefully you know what I mean :) After hearing your thoughts, I'm putting together a content plan over the next week or so that balances super awesome rewards for you guys, whilst not taking away from the development of The Artist as at the end of the day, this is the most important part of why you subscribed!

In other news...

Act Two has officially started! It's OFFICIAL!

JoeTheMerc and I have been working on a more detailed outline for the story in Act Two. We had the entire story planned out before we began act one, and as we get to develolping each act, we dive into the outline, expand it, and include all the plot elements in greater detail.

This has now been done, we are both happy, and writing will commence on the 20th June (tomorrow). JoeTheMerc is an absolute machine when it comes to writing, and he will have the second act written and complete before I've even posed the first render!

Alongisde the writing, I have started priming the new locations that you'll see in Act Two. Setting up the scenes, lighting them, dressing our wonderful characters, and making sure everything translates over into our art style well. So far, everything has gone far better than what I'd hoped for! 

Xaos is still working hard finalising the Steam version which should be available soon. Steam isn't the easiest store to navigate for a developer, and there are A LOT of things to tick off and get perfect before they allow you to release. All we need to do on this front is remove all mention of Patreon (They don't allow it) as we left one tiny mention in there and didn't realise, and then we just need to plug in the achievements so they unlock as you play.

That's all for this week! We will post updates on development every sunday if there's enough to discuss and share with you - keep an eye out for more previews of how Act Two is coming along! :)
